concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 requires computing the absolute percentage change in MAE for the bottom [deferred] target subset, but no task in tasks.md creates or records this metric.

Success Criterion SC-003 requires reporting the mean rank‑shift of the top‑10 features; tasks only generate the rank‑shift CSV (T038) but no task computes or records the aggregated mean rank‑shift value.
The plan’s contracts section expects a SHAP comparison schema file (shap_comparison.schema.yaml) to be produced, yet there is no task that creates this contract file.
